about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-cis78 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The first line of the Remember box is missing, so the note starts in the middle of a sentence.
findings.evidence: source: "Construction workers have a high risk of developing lung diseases" / tree: "developing lung diseases because many common tasks can create high dust levels."

findings.problem: The separate line "See overleaf for examples of good practice ..." is merged into step 3.
findings.evidence: source: "3 Use the right mask." / tree: "Use the right mask. See overleaf for examples of good practice ..."

findings.problem: The Remember box is placed between steps 2 and 3 of the numbered list.
findings.evidence: tree: "Wet cutting and on-tool extraction are both effective;" then "Remember" then "Use the right mask."

findings.problem: All the body text of the page, the three numbered steps and the guidance notice, is held only as labels of one figure and not as text sections.
findings.evidence: tree labels: "1. Plan your work –", "Don’t cut if you don’t", "need to. Put channels"

findings.problem: Stray characters from the cross and tick marks are mixed into the step text.
findings.evidence: source: "energy devices like block splitters?" / tree: "energy devices like block 8 4" "splitters? They are just as"; source: "the dust cloud. On-tool extraction" / tree: "the dust cloud. On-tool 4" "8"
